author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: निर्मलत्वादिफलं च किमित्यतो विविच्याह ॥ सत्त्वमित्यादिना । ज्ञानं परापरतत्त्वविषयम्। लोभः स्वर्गादिविषयासक्तिः । भवत एवेत्यन्वयः । अज्ञानं च भवतीत्यर्थः ॥ १४.१७॥
translation:
From Satva knowledge is produced; and from Rajas is produced only desire; heedlessness and delusion are from Tamas, as also ignorance (17.)
V. Knowledge of Paratattava and Aparatattva, i.e., of the Supreme Being und of everything under Him. The desire with regard to the attainment of Svarga, &c. (17)
A. Though knowledge, desire, heedlessness, &c, are the product of the three Gunas, they are not the fruits or the ultimate consequences. Now these are stated in the following.
